description: This file defines an interface for a builder pattern used to construct instances of FilteredTopic with specified properties such as namespaces, filters, and extra fields. It includes method signatures for setting these properties, enabling a fluent API for building FilteredTopic objects.

classes.name: FilteredTopicBuilder
classes.description: An interface that provides a fluent API to build FilteredTopic instances, allowing configuration of namespaces, filters, and extra fields.

methods.name: withNamespaces
methods.description: Sets the namespaces for the filter; accepts a collection of strings, can be null.

methods.name: withFilter
methods.description: Sets an optional RQL filter for the topic; accepts a CharSequence, can be null.

methods.name: withExtraFields
methods.description: Sets the selector for extra fields to enrich outgoing signals; accepts a JsonFieldSelector, can be null.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a FilteredTopic instance based on the current configuration.
